name: OpenGate XR
summary:
Metagate's OpenGate XR is a webapp that lets you create your own Mixed Reality environment from your smartphone or PC completely independently!
 
- Register on the webapp (app.themetagate.it) via email or Google.
- Subscribe to log in with the same credentials on the OpenGate app on the viewer.
- Upload images, videos or 3D models that you can interact with in MR (move, scale and save position).
- Create a 3D travelling companion with customisable artificial intelligence (GPT based) that you can talk to in
